description: Dependency confusion / substitution — publish a malicious public package matching an internal name so build systems pull yours. Load on leaked internal package names (npm/PyPI/RubyGems/Maven), package.json/requirements with unknown deps, or private-registry setups. Signals: @scope/internal packages, non-public dep names in manifests, .npmrc/registry config leaks.
